new.analysis:
The athlete missed all runs in week 39, so the plan begins with a gradual volume increase and re‑establishes the habit. Only one quality session keeps the build phase in line with the 80/20 rule while preventing back‑to‑back hard days. Strides are included in the easy runs to reinforce form. The volume stays under 20 km to avoid overloading a new runner. Rest days are placed before and after the quality session to allow recovery.

This plan keeps the hard effort in a single 4‑interval day and spreads easy running across the rest of the week, maintaining a 75‑80% easy‑volume ratio.

The key focus for the week is returning to consistent running, monitoring heart rate, and keeping the quality session well below all‑out effort to protect the training base.
